empty_desc: When customers leave reviews on your products, they'll appear here for moderation.
confirm_delete_desc: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"'s review? This cannot be undone.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
confirm_delete_media_one: Its photo or voice note is deleted too
confirm_delete_media_other: Its {count} photos and voice note are deleted too
error_already_reviewed: This product was already reviewed from this order.
error_not_in_order: This order of the customer did not bring this product.
error_file_too_large: This file is too large. Send a photo under 8 MB, or a shorter voice note.
error_file_type: Send a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a voice note (WhatsApp, M4A, MP3, Ogg).
error_upload_missing: A file was not received. Remove it and send it again.
error_body_short_one: Write at least {count} character, or add a voice note.
error_body_short_other: Write at least {count} characters, or add a voice note.
error_customer_required: Choose the customer, or type the name to show.

media.dropped_one: {count} file sent with it could not be kept
media.dropped_other: {count} files sent with it could not be kept
media.remove_description: It is deleted from the review by {name}; the review stays.

add.title: Add a review a customer gave you
add.description: For a review received by WhatsApp, phone or in person. It shows the date you add it.
add.customer_hint: Optional: choose them to link one of their orders.
add.name: Name shown
add.name_hint: As it appears on the storefront — a first name is enough.
add.order_hint: Only a delivered order shows the review as a verified purchase.
add.order_none_found: No order of this customer brought this product
add.body_hint_one: At least {count} character, unless you add a voice note.
add.body_hint_other: At least {count} characters, unless you add a voice note.
add.files_hint: Up to 6 photos and 1 voice note. A WhatsApp voice message works as it is.
add.files_skipped_one: {count} file was left out: past the limit, or not a photo or voice note.
add.files_skipped_other: {count} files were left out: past the limit, or not a photo or voice note.
add.publish_hint: Off: it waits in the pending reviews.
add.done_pending: Review added; it waits in the pending reviews
add.done_processing: Review added; its files are being prepared
